data.one_liner: A package to generate, send, and verify one-time passwords via custom SMTP email servers.
data.what_it_does: Generates one-time passwords (OTPs) and sends them to user email addresses via a configured SMTP server. Provides built-in templates, verification, resending logic, and expiration tracking.
use_when: You need custom email-based OTP verification in your app using your own SMTP credentials.
You want pre-built responsive HTML email templates for sending authentication codes.
avoid_when: You rely on a built-in backend-as-a-service like Firebase or Supabase to manage authentication out-of-the-box.
You need to send emails securely without exposing SMTP server configurations in client-side code.
strengths: Supports multiple pre-built HTML templates with light and dark mode.
Cryptographically secure OTP generation using Random.secure().
Allows custom SMTP configuration and headers.
weaknesses: Requires exposing SMTP server credentials and passwords on the client side since emails are sent directly from the app.
Lacks a hosted server backend for centralized rate-limiting or secure token storage.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring an SMTP host, port, security type, username, and password using EmailOTP.setSMTP().
